title: Diajem Global Black News Evening Bulletin
tagline: Shaping the Black world from the African continent to the Caribbean and the Diaspora.
opening: Welcome to Diajem Global Black News. Shaping the Black world from the African continent to the Caribbean and the Diaspora. My name is Peet.
closing: That’s our global Black news for today. Please subscribe to our channel to support us. Our People. Our Story. Our Own Way. Thanks for watching.

stories.headline: South Africa Pushes Regional Dialogue on Migration Management Across SADC
stories.narration: We open today in Southern Africa, where the South African government has initiated calls for comprehensive continent-wide talks to address regional migration frameworks. Officials emphasize the necessity of coordinated multilateral strategies across the Southern African Development Community to streamline border management while supporting economic integration.
stories.lowerThird: SOUTH AFRICA CALLS FOR CONTINENTAL MIGRATION DIALOGUE
stories.callout: Focus on SADC regional frameworks and coordinated border policy.

stories.headline: Security Escalation Reported in Galkayo as Regional Forces Take Positions
stories.narration: Turning to the Horn of Africa, security developments are unfolding in Somalia following movements by regional forces near Galkayo. Local authorities report shifts in territorial oversight along key transport corridors, prompting renewed calls from regional bodies to prioritize stability and institutional dialogue.
stories.lowerThird: SOMALIA: SECURITY SHIFTS REPORTED NEAR GALKAYO
stories.callout: Regional authorities emphasize need for territorial stability.

stories.headline: Interpol Flags Cyber Threats Facing East Africa’s Expanding Digital Infrastructure
stories.narration: In technology and regional infrastructure, Interpol has released a detailed report highlighting significant digital threat exposure across East Africa. As nations like Kenya accelerate financial technology adoption, law enforcement agencies are recommending immediate upgrades to cross-border cyber protocols and regulatory frameworks.
stories.lowerThird: INTERPOL FLAGS DIGITAL CYBER THREATS IN EAST AFRICA
stories.callout: Rapid FinTech expansion drives demand for upgraded security.

stories.headline: African Development Bank Allocates $4.3 Million to Strengthen Natural Capital Integration
stories.narration: In development finance, the African Development Bank has approved a four point three million dollar fund to assist thirteen member countries. This initiative focuses on incorporating natural capital and environmental assets directly into national economic policy planning.
stories.lowerThird: AfDB APPROVES $4.3M FOR CONTINENTAL NATURAL CAPITAL
stories.callout: 13 nations to integrate environmental assets into economic planning.

stories.headline: Africa CDC Issues Alert Over Urban Spread of Invasive Disease Vectors
stories.narration: On public health across the continent, the Africa CDC has issued an advisory concerning fast-spreading invasive mosquito species in urban centers. Epidemiologists warn that shifting climate patterns require intensified surveillance to protect dense metropolitan populations.
stories.lowerThird: AFRICA CDC ISSUES URBAN PUBLIC HEALTH ADVISORY
stories.callout: Surveillance increased for invasive vectors in metropolitan areas.

stories.headline: WFP Highlights Climate Risks Facing Millions Across Vulnerable Agricultural Zones
stories.narration: Finally, the World Food Programme has outlined potential food security challenges tied to global climate anomalies affecting East and Southern Africa. International agencies are requesting proactive logistics preparation to safeguard agricultural yield supply chains.
stories.lowerThird: WFP WARNS OF CLIMATE RISKS TO REGIONAL FOOD SUPPLY
stories.callout: Agencies request early action for vulnerable agricultural zones.
